title: DLE webhook payload: domain.verification_failed
description: A domain's association files stopped verifying (FR-143, T-04). Envelope per docs/zadanie.md B.7.4.

event.description: Event type. Fixed for this schema.

id.description: Delivery identifier the receiver uses for replay protection.

occurred_at.description: When the underlying event happened, ISO 8601 with an offset.

data.description: Event payload. Every member is a string: the envelope is a flat string map on purpose, so a receiver never has to guess at a type it was not told about.

host.description: The host whose association files failed.

takeover_risk.description: Whether the failure looks like a dangling CNAME (T-04).

aasa.description: Status of the Apple App Site Association check.

assetlinks.description: Status of the Digital Asset Links check.
